note: Haskell County is unlikely to zone (Texas counties generally cannot zone). City of Haskell publishes its zoning map only in an embedded viewer with no queryable REST service found; its ordinance is on ecode360. City of Stamford publishes its zone map only as a PDF (ZONE-MAP.pdf) and its ordinance as PDF. No ArcGIS REST zoning layer for Haskell County or its cities was found in ArcGIS Hub/Online or web searches.
